sub_questions.question: Why are the Sandbox app's API calls suddenly failing with rate limit errors?
Does upgrading to Team provide SSO for members (40 people logging in with company SSO)?

claims.claim: Sandbox workspaces are capped at 5,000 API calls per month.
claims.guide_evidence: | Sandbox | Free | 200 credits, one-time (does not renew) | 1 | 5 | 50 | 50 MB | 5,000 calls/month |

claims.claim: The rate limit errors are likely due to usage growth hitting the 5,000 call monthly ceiling.
Both Professional and Team remove the Dify-imposed API cap entirely.
Upgrading to Team gives the workspace single sign-on support for all members.
claims.guide_evidence: Enterprise is a separately sold... for organizations that need capabilities beyond what any Cloud tier offers, such as single sign-on, detailed audit logging, and a dedicated customer success manager

claims.claim: The 40 users would be able to log in with company SSO right away after the upgrade.
claims.guide_evidence: capabilities beyond what any Cloud tier offers, such as single sign-on

customer_safety_issues: Tells the customer that Team includes SSO, which the guide says is not available on any Cloud tier. The customer could buy the wrong plan based on this.
evaluation.rationale: The API rate limit explanation is grounded in the guide. The SSO claim is wrong: the guide puts SSO in Enterprise, beyond any Cloud tier, and says SSO setup should go to a specialist team. A customer with 40 users could buy Team expecting SSO and not get it, so this is critical, and the answer should have pointed them to sales or the Enterprise team.
